title: Practice: Lead Side Kick
source: Practice Mode tutorial. Words from the app's Technique Library (practiceData.js › Kickboxing › Lead Side Kick: cues, mistakes, next). Karate name yoko geri (横蹴り); the thrusting version is yoko geri kekomi. Footage: the owner's clip 19 (ring, 2026-11-02), raw-footage/practice/p19.mp4, four shots joined in InShot (cuts at 4.99, 7.57 and 11.93 s): three kicks facing the camera, one from behind at 45°.

props.description: Lateral thrust kick from the lead leg
props.hookSub: Lead side kick. Yoko geri. 20 seconds.

cues.label: CHAMBER
cues.say: Coach: "Knee up to the hip first. The chamber is the kick."

cues.label: HEEL
cues.say: Coach: "Push the heel out, toes pulled back. Toes break. Heels don't."

cues.label: LEAN
cues.say: Coach: "Your body goes the other way. That lean is the range and the power."

watch.label: TOES
watch.say: Coach: "Land on the toes and you break them. Pull them back and drive the heel."
